facts.fact: 她与 Clay 把毯子搬到草坡上露宿；他说绿闪光只是水手的传说，「也许只是故事，也许是真的」
facts.anchor: Might only be a tall tale, or might be true.

facts.fact: 岛在往南漂、靠近赤道；她按时日与月相计算可能受孕的日子并避开
facts.anchor: I count my cycle, measuring the days alongside the patterns of the moon.

facts.fact: 她给他读《罗伯特·彭斯诗与歌全集》
facts.anchor: The Complete Poems and Songs of Robert Burns.

facts.fact: 近一周无雨，第十五天菜园开始枯死；他们一桶桶搬水
facts.anchor: Day fifteen since we last had rain

facts.fact: 夜里雨来，随后变成飓风：「This is no storm. It’s a hurricane.」
facts.anchor: This is no storm. It’s a hurricane.

facts.fact: 飓风把他建的菜园、温室、羊棚、鸡舍全部摧毁
岛被推到一处陌生的热带海岸，礁石卡住它不再漂走
facts.anchor: The reef refuses to let go of the island

facts.fact: 他们在废弃度假村找到一部老式电话，没有拨号音；她按下 Nana 的号码只听见沉默
facts.anchor: I listen for the dial tone, but there’s nothing.

facts.fact: 丛林里的香蕉树是成排种的——有人工痕迹
facts.anchor: “They’re in rows,” he says. “They’ve been planted.”

facts.fact: 他说「I’d marry ye if I could」，随后「I promise it now, even without an altar.」把贝壳当戒指
facts.anchor: I promise it now, even without an altar.

facts.fact: 他用盖尔语说「Mo ghràdh」（我的爱）
结尾：「We make love on an island we have no name for.」
facts.anchor: We make love on an island we have no name for.
